custom/vpn-proton.label: ProtonVPN
custom/vpn-proton.execute: bash -c 'if nmcli -t -f TYPE connection show --active 2>/dev/null | grep -q vpn; then echo "{\"alt\": \"connected\"}"; fi'

custom/vpn-it.label: Custom VPN
custom/vpn-it.execute: bash -c 'if openvpn3 sessions-list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Client connected"; then echo "{\"alt\": \"connected\"}"; fi'

custom/vpn-off.label: VPN
custom/vpn-off.execute: bash -c 'if ! nmcli -t -f TYPE connection show --active 2>/dev/null | grep -q vpn && ! openvpn3 sessions-list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Client connected"; then echo "{\"alt\": \"disconnected\"}"; fi'
